landing.heroDesc: Track income & expenses, monitor debts, create budgets, achieve financial goals together as a family — all in one app.
landing.featuresDesc: Complete features to manage family finances in one app.
landing.ctaBottomDesc: Start for free, no charges. Your data is safe and stored in the cloud.
landing.feature1Desc: Record every transaction with category, wallet, and notes. View history with filters and quick search.
landing.feature2Desc: Create Cash, Bank, or E-Wallet wallets. Transfer between wallets and monitor real-time balance.
landing.feature3Desc: Visualize finances with interactive charts. Export to PDF & CSV for archiving.
landing.feature4Desc: Create budgets per category, monitor usage. Set automatic savings targets every month.
landing.feature5Desc: Track debts/receivables with active, paid, or overdue status. Pay in installments.
landing.feature6Desc: Automatically record monthly/weekly transactions like salary, electricity bills, or routine installments.
landing.feature7Desc: Join a family group. All members can view and record transactions together.
landing.feature8Desc: Login with fingerprint, Google authentication, and data securely stored on Firebase Cloud.
landing.feature9Desc: Access from Android (Flutter) and Web (Next.js). Data stays synced in real-time without reconfiguration.

marketing.homeDesc: Empower your family with private finance workflows that scale, seamless budgeting, wallet, and reporting tools for modern households.
marketing.guideTitle: Run your family finance workflow with clarity.
marketing.guideDesc: Family Finance combines Android-first recording, family collaboration, shared budgeting, and web monitoring into one private system.
marketing.step1Desc: Register, invite family members, and keep every household account in one secure workspace.
marketing.step2Desc: Create cash, bank, or e-wallet balances, then organize spending with custom categories.
marketing.step3Desc: Record income, expenses, debt, savings, recurring entries, and transfers with clean history.
marketing.step4Desc: Monitor trends, budget discipline, and family progress from Android and companion web dashboard.
marketing.startAndroidMonitorWeb: Start from Android. Monitor from web.
marketing.downloadDesc: Install the latest APK, create or join a family, then use the web dashboard for reports, monitoring, and admin operations.

guide.title: How to use Family Finance
guide.desc: Nine steps, from creating an account to following your family's money on the web.
guide.ctaDesc: Install the Android app to record, then follow along together on the web.
guide.step1Desc: Use email or Google. One account works on your phone and on the web.
guide.step1Detail1: Install the APK, then choose Register on the sign-in screen
guide.step1Detail2: Passwords need at least 8 characters with letters and numbers
guide.step1Detail3: Open the verification email we send to activate the account
guide.step2Desc: A family shares the same records, budgets, and reports.
guide.step2Detail1: Open Family, then choose Create a new family
guide.step2Detail2: Share the 8-character invite code with your partner or relatives
guide.step2Detail3: Members enter that code in Family to join
guide.step2Detail4: Without a family, your records stay private to you
guide.step3Desc: Tailor categories and record recurring bills so nothing slips.
guide.step3Detail1: Open Profile, then Categories to add or edit categories
guide.step3Detail2: Categories are shared by every family member
guide.step3Detail3: Add recurring bills such as electricity, internet, or insurance
guide.step3Detail4: The app reminds you before a bill is due
guide.step4Desc: Record each transaction on your phone; others see it right away.
guide.step4Detail1: Tap the + button, then choose Income or Spending
guide.step4Detail2: Pick a category, then enter the amount, date, and a note
guide.step4Detail3: Recurring transactions can be created automatically
guide.step4Detail4: Only the author or the family owner can delete a transaction
guide.step5Desc: Cap spending per category and work toward shared goals.
guide.step5Detail1: Open Budget to set a monthly limit per category
guide.step5Detail2: The app warns you when a budget is nearly spent
guide.step5Detail3: Create savings goals, including gold tracked in grams
guide.step5Detail4: Unspent budget can roll over to the next month
guide.step6Desc: Track who owes whom, and the repayments.
guide.step6Detail1: Open Debts, then choose Debt or Receivable
guide.step6Detail2: Enter the name, amount, and due date
guide.step6Detail3: Record each payment; the remaining balance updates itself
guide.step6Detail4: Mark it paid when it is settled
guide.step7Desc: Open the web dashboard for summaries and reports on a big screen.
guide.step7Detail1: Sign in here with the same account you use on your phone
guide.step7Detail2: Records from the phone appear on the web within seconds
guide.step7Detail3: See 6 or 12 months of cash flow and spending by category
guide.step7Detail4: The web is for reviewing; recording stays in the app
guide.step8Desc: Protect your account and your family's data.
guide.step8Detail1: Turn on fingerprint unlock in Settings
guide.step8Detail2: Never share your invite code outside the family
guide.step8Detail3: Sign out on phones or computers that are not yours
guide.step8Detail4: Forgot your password? Use Forgot password on the sign-in page
